verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own product page for the RTX 5080 lists Project G-Assist, an AI assistant that runs on the RTX PC and helps users tune, control, and optimize their system. That is first-party natural-language-style control of the GPU, but the evidence is one brief marketing line, and it never explicitly describes natural-language command input or which settings can be controlled. missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language command input, scope of GPU settings controllable by G-Assist, depth of first-party docs, independent/hands-on corroboration, any note on the 'Project' (preview) maturity status.
